description: Shared fixture corpus for checking that a changed Scene document stays within what its editing scope may change. @cratis/scene.engine (for_applyEdit/when_checking_the_shared_document_change_corpus) and Cratis.Scene.Engine (SceneDocumentChangeValidation, Engine.Specs/for_SceneDocumentChangeValidation) run the same cases. A case with an edit is also run through applyEdit with the test catalog of engine/editing/given/a_scene_document.ts: an accepted case must be applied and produce exactly the submitted document; a refused case must be refused by the editor with each of the expected codes, and the submitted document is what a client that bypassed the editor would send instead. A case without an edit is only about the server: the editor never produces such a document. references holds the other stored documents the scope inherits from, by the name of the template each one holds. previous is null for a first save.
